column3: “the lowland” renders “the Shephelah”; NASB supplies “of it.”
“acted craftily” renders “acted with cunning”; “set out as envoys” renders a verb whose form is uncertain, and “mended” renders “tied up.”
“the men of Israel” renders the collective “the man of Israel” (also in verse 7).
“within our land” renders “in my midst”; “we” is plural for the Hebrew singular “I.”
“because of the fame of” renders “to the name of.”
“because of the very long journey” renders “from the very great length of the journey.”
“the men of Israel” renders “the men”; “ask for the counsel of the LORD” renders “ask the mouth of the LORD.”
“neighbors” renders “near to him”; “within their land” renders “in his midst.”
“called for” renders “summoned”; “within our land” renders “in our midst.”
“never cease being slaves” renders “a slave shall not be cut off from you”; NASB adds “both.”
